# Spark Control Center 1.5.0

Optional S3/MinIO and GCS access, a bundled code editor, tenant-defined permissions and production-first Helm configuration.

## Optional object storage

- Add an independent stateless `spark-control-center-object-storage` image and deployment. The feature is disabled by default and does not affect the main backend's readiness or workflow scheduling.
- Browse authorized S3/MinIO or GCS prefixes, upload/download objects, copy within a connection and delete single objects.
- Create, preview and edit supported UTF-8 text in a bundled Monaco editor with search/replace, multi-cursors and structural/syntax diagnostics. A configurable 1048576-byte default bounds editing and preview; larger files open truncated and read-only. Use conditional creation and ETag/generation conflict checks. Content is never executed or stored in PostgreSQL.
- Enforce per-user, per-tenant bucket/prefix/actions in the plugin. Administrators need explicit data grants and may delegate only their own scopes; viewer file actions follow these grants without changing Spark job permissions.
- Persist grants and compact operation audits including downloads and text creation in PostgreSQL. Upload parts do not generate individual audit records. Configure retention independently of Spark/workflow history.
- Use bounded transfer concurrency, resumable uploads and encrypted identity-bound upload tickets. Keep storage credentials and provider endpoints out of browser configuration.
- Support multiple allow-listed buckets and explicit all-bucket bootstrap grants for both S3/MinIO and GCS. Revoking a grant survives Pod replacement. Virtual folders have no modification timestamp.
- Provide one production values template in the packaged chart. Storage and NetworkPolicy are disabled by default; enable only the integrations you need. GCS uses a dedicated auto-created KSA and WIF, not service-account private keys.

## Tenant permissions

- New administrators default to the full-access `admin` tenant; new viewers default to `viewer`, with overview and Spark application access only.
- Configure namespaces, submission, termination/deletion, templates, workflows/schedules/history, alerts and storage per tenant. The sidebar and API enforce the policy; storage prefix/action grants remain an additional boundary.
- Preserve existing tenant assignments and historical projects on upgrade. Legacy tenant access is retained until explicitly configured. Back up PostgreSQL before upgrading.
- Use distinct module icons and distinguish text objects from other files.

## Deployment and acceptance

Back up PostgreSQL before upgrading. Use the same database containing the core user identities; separate plugin database credentials are supported, but an unrelated database without `local_users` is not.

Test in an isolated bucket/prefix first. Verify conditional-write support before enabling S3 edits/uploads. Older compatible servers may not support atomic conditional deletion; external concurrent replacement cannot be fully protected by a pre-delete version check.

Local checks cover frontend tests/build, Go test/vet, PostgreSQL and MinIO integration, container recovery, core workflow regression, Helm examples and desktop browser interactions. GCS upload-protocol tests are simulated; real WIF/IAM acceptance remains required.

Release assets: `spark-control-center-1.5.0.tar`, `spark-control-center-backend-1.5.0.tar`, `spark-control-center-object-storage-1.5.0.tar` and `spark-control-center-1.5.0.tgz`. Images have no private registry prefix. No checksum file is generated.
